# 移除：获取模型变量树
```

func GetVariableTreeView(c *gin.Context) {
	/*
		# 变量树接口, root节点只需要id, 其他子节点需要传变量名字, 只要模型编译状态为已编译, 就可以根据编译结果获取到变量树
		## 支持多运行仿真结果查询
		## id: 仿真记录id
		## variable_name: 模型变量名称
	*/
	var res ResponseData
	username := c.GetHeader("username")
	userSpaceId := c.GetHeader("space_id")
	packageId := c.Query("package_id")
	modelName := c.Query("model_name")
	parentNode := c.Query("parent_name")
	keyWords := c.Query("key_words")

	var modelTranslateStatusRecord DataBase.YssimModelTranslateStatus
	DB.Model(&DataBase.YssimModelTranslateStatus{}).
		Where("username = ? AND userspace_id = ? AND package_id = ? AND model_name = ?", username, userSpaceId, packageId, modelName).
		First(&modelTranslateStatusRecord)
	if modelTranslateStatusRecord.ID == "" || modelTranslateStatusRecord.CompileStatus != model.TranslateStatusCompiled {
		res.Err = "该模型未经过编译或编译产物已过时, 请重新编译"
		res.Status = 2
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, res)
		return
	}

	result := simulate.DymolaSimulationResultTree(modelTranslateStatusRecord.ModelDescriptionPath, parentNode, keyWords, "DM", "all", nil)

	sortByFirstLetter := func(i, j int) bool {
		// 从每个map中提取指定键的值进行比较
		value1 := fmt.Sprintf("%v", result[i]["variables"])
		value2 := fmt.Sprintf("%v", result[j]["variables"])
		return strings.ToLower(string(value1[0])) < strings.ToLower(string(value2[0]))
	}

	// 使用排序函数对切片进行排序
	sort.Slice(result, sortByFirstLetter)

	res.Data = result
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, res)
}
```
